data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 claims a compatibility relation that SRC_007 'numerically overcounts by $54 ($909−$855),' but this causal account is factually wrong. The premium-only decomposition (47×18 + 7×9) yields $909, not because of any overcounting or error, but because it is the correct algebraic equivalent of the standard piecewise method under FLSA, which also yields $909 (40×18 + 7×27 = 720+189 = 909). The target's entire 'reduces to a decomposition mismatch' mechanism is built on a false premise that the standard method yields $855; it actually yields $909. The artifact provides no causal mechanism for the asserted $855—it merely presupposes it, then misattributes the difference to double-counting.
